newsitem.title: POLAND: Handlowy sees Kety 1996 net up 32.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Handlowy sees Kety 1996 net up 32.4 pct.

text.p: The brokerage unit of Polish Bank Handlowy said on Monday it saw Polish aluminium plant Kety SA net profit rising to 31.5 million zlotys in 1996 and 37.5 million in 1997, up from last year's 23.8 million.
Handlowy said in a weekly report that Kety's net sales should grow to 380 million zlotys in 1996 and 450 million next year, up from last year's 377.1 million zlotys.
Handlowy said Kety's likely growth of earnings would stem from an expected strong increase in demand for aluminium goods in Poland's construction and car industries.
It also praised Kety for its clear development strategy and its a well-established position on the Polish market but noted that domestic and foreign competition was growing in the sector.
Handlowy did not give any recommendation because it acts as Kety's stocks exchange member-specialist.
